spec.description: Instant view of how much block storage is provisioned, how much of it is actually written, and which volumes are close to full.

spec.title: Provisioned
spec.description: Total PVC capacity we are paying for, across the selected scope.

spec.expr:
sum(sum by (cluster) (
  clamp_max(
    topk(1,
        kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", label_product!=""} * 2
      or
        kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}
    ) by (cluster, namespace)
    , 1)
  * on (cluster, namespace) group_right(label_environment_kind, label_project, label_product, label_client)
  sum by (cluster, namespace) (pvc:capacity_bytes:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})
))

spec.title: Actually used
spec.description: Bytes actually written inside those volumes.

spec.expr:
sum(sum by (cluster) (
  clamp_max(
    topk(1,
        kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", label_product!=""} * 2
      or
        kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}
    ) by (cluster, namespace)
    , 1)
  * on (cluster, namespace) group_right(label_environment_kind, label_project, label_product, label_client)
  sum by (cluster, namespace) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})
))

spec.title: Utilisation
spec.description: Used over provisioned. Block storage is billed on provisioned size, so the gap is money spent on empty space.

spec.title: Volumes closest to full
spec.description: Per-PVC fill ratio, highest first. These are an operational risk rather than a cost one: a volume at 100% takes its workload down.

spec.title: Largest volume that fits, production
spec.description: Free space on the single emptiest production node. A volume must fit on one node, so this is the largest one we could create right now — not the pool total.

spec.title: Largest volume that fits, non-production
spec.description: Same for nodes without the production role.

spec.title: Nodes that could take a $fit_tib TiB volume
spec.description: Schedulable nodes with at least $fit_tib TiB free, by pool. Zero means the volume cannot be created at all, however much free space the pool reports in total.

spec.title: Free volume space per node
spec.description: Every schedulable node with local storage, emptiest first. Use it to see whether the pool total is spread thin or sitting on one node.

spec.title: FinOps - Storage (PVC) - State

spec.name: max_shown
spec.label: Max volumes shown
spec.description: How many PVCs the table lists, fullest first.

spec.name: fit_tib
spec.label: Volume size to fit (TiB)
spec.description: Size of the volume you want to create. The bar gauge counts nodes with at least this much free.
